objective: Al terminar usas con naturalidad las colocaciones con make, do, take y get (make a decision, do research, take a risk, get in touch).

warmup.prompt_es: El inglés elige el verbo según el sustantivo: se dice 'make a mistake' pero 'do homework'. Aprender colocaciones completas evita errores y suena natural.

text: When I moved to Dublin to study, I made a lot of mistakes. I made an effort to speak English all day, but I often made the wrong choice of words. I did my best to take part in class, although at first I took it for granted that everyone would understand my accent.

Before leaving, I had done some research and made a list of things to do. I took a risk by choosing a small flat far from the centre, but it paid off: I made friends with my flatmates, who helped me get used to the city. We took turns cooking and doing the washing-up.

After a few months, I got the impression that I was making progress. I took an exam, got a good mark and decided to take advantage of every opportunity. I got in touch with a local company and did voluntary work at weekends. It did me good: I took responsibility for small tasks and got to know the community.
Looking back, I would not take back a single decision. Moving away was hard, but it made all the difference.
input.es: Mi primer año en el extranjero. Cuando me mudé a Dublín para estudiar, cometí muchos errores. Hice un esfuerzo por hablar inglés todo el día, pero a menudo elegí mal las palabras. Hice todo lo posible por participar en clase, aunque al principio daba por sentado que todos entenderían mi acento. Antes de irme, había investigado un poco y había hecho una lista de cosas por hacer. Me arriesgué eligiendo un piso pequeño lejos del centro, pero valió la pena: hice amigos con mis compañeros de piso, que me ayudaron a acostumbrarme a la ciudad. Nos turnábamos para cocinar y fregar los platos. Tras unos meses, tuve la impresión de que estaba progresando. Hice un examen, saqué buena nota y decidí aprovechar todas las oportunidades. Me puse en contacto con una empresa local e hice trabajo voluntario los fines de semana. Me hizo bien: asumí la responsabilidad de pequeñas tareas y llegué a conocer la comunidad. Mirando atrás, no retiraría ni una sola decisión. Mudarme fue difícil, pero marcó la diferencia.

md_es: **Colocaciones con make, do, take y get**
| Verbo | Idea general | Colocaciones |
| **make** | crear, producir, decidir | *make a decision / a mistake / an effort / progress / a suggestion / a living / money / friends / a difference / a point / a complaint* |
| **do** | actividades, tareas, trabajo | *do homework / research / the washing-up / business / damage / harm / good / your best / a favour / an exam (examinarse)* |
| **take** | acciones, tiempo, riesgos | *take a risk / advantage / part / place / turns / responsibility / a break / notice / into account / for granted / a photo* |
| **get** | recibir, llegar a ser | *get in touch / used to / the impression / a mark / ready / lost / a job / better / to know someone / a result* |
**Contrastes importantes**
- *Make an exam* (✘ crear un examen) vs *take / sit an exam* (hacer un examen) y *do an exam* (informal).
- *Make a photo* (✘) → *take a photo*.
- *Do a mistake* (✘) → *make a mistake*.
- *Make homework* (✘) → *do homework*.
- *Make a favour* (✘) → *do someone a favour*.
- *Take / have a shower* (✔) pero *make a shower* (✘).
**Make vs do**
- **Make** → resultado visible, algo creado: *make a cake, make a plan, make a noise, make a decision.*
- **Do** → actividad, tarea, no necesariamente resultado: *do the housework, do research, do your best.*
**Take vs get**
- **Take** → acción deliberada, tiempo, medio: *take the bus, take 20 minutes, take a decision (UK: make).*
- **Get** → cambio de estado o recibir: *get angry, get a letter, get the train.*
**Expresiones fijas**

- *It makes sense. · It doesn't make any difference. · Make sure you lock the door. · Make up your mind. · Do me a favour. · It did me good. · Take it easy. · Take care. · Get over it. · Get along with.*
**Errores típicos**
- ✘ *I did a mistake in the test.* → ✔ *I made a mistake in the test.*
- ✘ *She makes her homework after school.* → ✔ *She does her homework after school.*
- ✘ *We made a photo of the group.* → ✔ *We took a photo of the group.*
- ✘ *Can you make me a favour?* → ✔ *Can you do me a favour?*
- ✘ *He made an exam yesterday.* → ✔ *He took an exam yesterday.*
**Ojo:** en *take part in*, la preposición es *in*, no *of*. *Take into account* = tener en cuenta. *Take for granted* = dar por sentado.
Pronunciación: *research* /rɪˈsɜːtʃ/ (nombre, acento en la 2.ª) · *advantage* /ədˈvɑːntɪdʒ/ · *responsibility* /rɪˌspɒnsəˈbɪləti/ · *mistake* /mɪˈsteɪk/.
